$\frac{m^{2}-2m}{8}=0.5$
$m^{2}-2m=4$
$m^{2}-2m-4=0$
$m=\frac{2\pm\sqrt{4+16}}{2}$
$m=1\pm\sqrt{5}$
$m\approx 3.24$ or $m\approx -1.24$
